categories.name: Advice
categories.description: Short guides to caring for your teeth.

posts.title: Longer Saturday hours from November
posts.excerpt: From 7 November we open on Saturdays until 14:00, with two hygienists on duty.
posts.content:
From Saturday 7 November the clinic opens from 9:00 to 14:00 every Saturday, with two hygienists and one dentist on duty.

Saturday slots fill quickly; book online or call the front desk.

posts.title: A first check-up for children, in ten minutes
posts.excerpt: What happens at a first check-up for children under six, and how to prepare.
posts.content:
A first check-up for a small child takes about ten minutes. We count teeth, look at the gums and show parents how to brush.

Check-ups for children under twelve are free with most insurance plans.

posts.title: Floss or interdental brushes: which is better?
posts.excerpt: Our hygienist explains when to use each, and how to pick the right size.
posts.content:
Both work. Interdental brushes are easier for wider gaps and braces; floss suits tight contacts.

Ask at your next clean and we will measure your gaps and give you a sample set.
